source: Rubeaud, Beillouin, Köthke, Six, Walder, Schievano & Kay
title: Global Bias-Aware Synthesis of Meta-Analyses Reveals Agroforestry's Potential for Improving Soil Health
topic: Bias-adjusted global quantitative synthesis of 26 meta-analyses (1590 primary studies) evaluating the effects of agroforestry systems on soil organic carbon, chemical/physical/biological soil quality, water regulation, nutrient leaching, and erosion control
